assessments.name: Self and peer assessment of team contribution
assessments.description: Self and peer assessment of team contribution.

assessments.name: Problem definition
assessments.description: Submission of draft "how might we" statement and 1 engineering requirement per context area. Task completed during week 3 tutorial.

assessments.name: Hurdle Quiz
assessments.description: A multiple-choice quiz covering key concepts. Students must attain a minimum of 80%. Supplementary assessment may be offered to students who fail the pass the hurdle requirement.
assessments.type: In-person practical, skills, or performance task or test

assessments.name: Poster Submission
assessments.description: Poster detailing proposed solution (at the time of submission) and 1min pitch of solution. A group mark will be awarded. Individual marks will be calculated using moderation by the SparkPLUS RPF factor.

assessments.name: Poster Exhibition
assessments.description: Q&A following poster pitch. In tutorial during week 9. A group mark will be awarded. Individual marks will be calculated using moderation by the SparkPLUS RPF factor.
assessments.type: Q&A following presentation, submission or placement

assessments.name: Conceptual Design Proposal
assessments.description: Written design proposal report. A group mark will be awarded. Individual marks will be calculated using moderation by the SparkPLUS RPF factor.

assessments.name: Reflection
assessments.description: Interactive oral reflecting on project outcomes and teamwork contributions. During week 13 tutorial. Students must attain a minimum of 50%. Supplementary assessment may be offered to students who fail the pass the hurdle requirement.

assessments.name: Attendance
assessments.description:
Attendance at weekly tutorials between weeks 1 and 12 (inclusive) for at least 75% of tutorial duration (1.5 hours). 

Minimum of 10/12 tutorials are required to meet this requirement.
